_note: OneTrainer headless config — the blueprint's recipe: rank 16 / alpha 16,
AdamW (full precision), LR 1e-4, masked training, bf16 LoRA out.
ADAMW_8BIT was the blueprint's choice and bitsandbytes refused it at
step 1 (grad bf16 + uint8 state unsupported, 2026-08-25). 8-bit states
exist to shrink FULL fine-tunes; a rank-16 LoRA's optimizer is tiny, so
plain AdamW costs nothing here and removes the failure class.
REGENERATED 2026-08-25 against TrainConfig config_version 11 after the
v6 original died in __migration_8 (KeyError 'prior') on first contact —
exactly the drift its own note predicted. This is a PARTIAL config:
__version matches current so no migrations run, and every absent key
takes OneTrainer's default. Field names verified against the repo's
'Flux Dev.1/#flux LoRA.json' preset and TrainConfig.default_values().
output_model_format must be a LORA format: plain SAFETENSORS is the
full-model enum and LoRASaverMixin raises NotImplementedError on it —
which silently ate every periodic save on 2026-08-25 while training
sailed on. COMFY_LORA writes the single-file form ComfyUI loads.
There is no top-level 'steps' field — train.py converts the requested
step count into {EPOCHS} (ceil(steps / dataset size), batch 1).
workspace/cache/debug dirs are pinned under {OUTPUT_DIR}/.. because the
defaults are RELATIVE, which would put subject latents and sample
renders on the /weights volume that survives Terminate.
sample_prompt: photo of {TRIGGER}, frontal portrait, soft light
